history.text: The Medes formed the first Iranian state on the plateau.
Cyrus the Great founded the Achaemenid empire, which reached from the Indus to the Aegean.
The Parthians took the plateau and held Rome's eastern frontier for centuries.
Ardashir I founded the Sasanian empire and made Zoroastrianism the state religion.
Local Iranian dynasties regained power between Arab and Turkic rule.
Shah Ismail founded the Safavid dynasty and made Shia Islam the state faith.
Nader Shah seized the throne and campaigned as far as Delhi.
Karim Khan Zand ruled from Shiraz in a rare period of calm.

worthSeeing.title: Persepolis:
worthSeeing.text: Ruins of the Persian Empire's ceremonial capital, one of antiquity's greatest sites.

worthSeeing.title: Isfahan:
worthSeeing.text: Half the world was said to be Isfahan - mosques, bridges, and bazaars of surpassing beauty.

worthSeeing.title: Shiraz:
worthSeeing.text: City of poets, gardens, and wine heritage near the ruins of Persepolis.
